newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldier kills Palestinian assailant.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier kills Palestinian assailant.

text.p: An Israeli soldier shot dead a Palestinian who stabbed and lightly wounded another soldier near a Jewish settlement in the West Bank on Tuesday, the army said.
An army spokesman said the Palestinian attacked troops outside the Elon Moreh settlement near Nablus, drawing gunfire from one of the soldiers.
"An Israeli soldier was lightly wounded after being stabbed by a Palestinian at the Elon Moreh junction near Nablus," the spokesman said.
"Soldiers on patrol in the area were attacked by the Palestinian assailant. One soldier fired his gun in response and killed the attacker," he said.
A witness who arrived after the shooting said the Palestinian had a bullet wound in the chest and was lying in a pool of blood. He appeared to be in his 20s, the witness said.

PLO officials said Israel had closed off the area and initially prevented Palestinian policemen from investigating the incident. They said the Nablus police commander was later allowed to inspect the scene.
Israel handed over parts of the West Bank and Gaza Strip to Palestinian rule under peace deals since 1993 but much of the area remains under Israeli military control.
Around 130,000 Jewish settlers live among one million Palestinians in the West Bank which Israel captured in the 1967 Middle East war.
